text.S1: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs. One day, they left their mother to go see the world. All summer long, they made lots of friends. The third little pig, unlike his brothers, remembered his mother’s advice that they should work hard to succeed in life. “We need to build a house to shelter us from the cold during winter and also to protect us from the big bad wolf”. However, each little pig took the decision to build a house for himself.
text.S2: Once there lived three little piggies. One day, they all decided to leave their mother to go out into the wilderness to wonder about. During summer they made many friends. The third little piggy thought differently from the other two piggies by remembering their mother’s advice that in life they should learn to work hard for them to develop. “We should build a house to protect ourselves from cold weather during winter season and protect ourselves from a big vicious hungry wolf.” In the process, each little piggy decided to build their own houses seperately from each other.
text.T1: Ka nako yeñwi nekuna ni tukulube totulaalu. Zazi leliñwi twasiya bo maatona ni kuya kwa kubona lifasi. Mbumbi kaufela, twapanga bulikani ni totuñata-ñata. Kakulube kabulaalu kanahanela musili kufita totubeli ka kuhupula kelezo ya bo maakona yakuli tulukela kusebeza kataata kuli tukone kuzwelapili mwa bupilo. “Lulukela kuyaha ndu kuli ikone kulufa mukunda kusaba silami ka nako ya maliha mane ni kulusileleza kwa luwawa lolutuna.” Nihakulicwalo, kakulube ni kakulube kaba ni mulelo wakona wa kuyaha ndu yakona kanoosi.

text.S1: The first little pig, the laziest of the three, decided to build a nice little straw house. “As it will take only a day to build, I will have plenty of time to play!” he said. “Yes, but it will not be strong enough,” said the second little pig, and added, “I’m going to build a house of wood.” “And me, I’ll build my house of brick,” said the third little pig. “I’m afraid that neither the house built of straw nor the house built of wood are strong enough to keep the big bad wolf away.” The first and second little pigs didn’t take advice from the third little pig and they all built their houses the way they thought best.
text.S2: The first laziest little piggy of them all decided to build a nice little house of straw. “From the look of things, It will only take me a day to build and will spend all of my spare time playing,” the first leasiest little piggy said. “Yes! However, it will not be a strong house,” said the second piggy and continued to say, “I will build a house made of poles.” “I will build a brick house,” said the third little piggy. “My fear is that a house built of straw or a house built of poles will not hinder a big vicious wolf from entering the house.” The first and second little piggies did not acept the third little piggy’s advice and as a result they both built their different houses as they saw it fit.
text.T1: Kakulube kapili, kakalondile ka kufitisisa mwahalaatona kalela kuicahela kabuma kakande ka bucwañi bobuomile. “Kubona kukani ingela feela lizazi lililiñwi kuyaha, mi nika siyala ni nako yeñata ya kubapala!” abulela. “Eni, kono haina kuba ndu yetiile.” kwabulela kakulube kabubeli, mi kaekeza kali, “Nikayaha ndu ya likota.” “Mi na, nikayaha ndu ya masitina,” kwabulela kakulube kabulaalu. "Nisaba kuli ndu yeyahilwe fa bucwañi kapa yeyahilwe fa likota haikoni kupalelwisa luwawa lolubuhali ni butuna kukena.” Kakulube kapili ni kabubeli twapalelwa kuutwisisa kelezo ya kakulube kabulaalu mi kacwalo, twaicahela mandu ka moo netu nahanela kuli kulukile.

text.S1: But the next day the big bad wolf came. The wolf was hungry and wanted a delicious pig for dinner. “Come out, I want to speak to you,” roared the big bad wolf to the house of straw. “No way, I would rather stay where I am,” replied the first little pig in a weak voice. “I’ll make you come out, whether you like it or not,” growled the big bad wolf, and he blew with all his strength. The fragile little straw house soon fell down. There was only one thing the first little pig could do and that was to flee.
text.S2: The following day, a big vicious wolf came to the first laziest little piggy’s straw house. The big vicious wolf was hungry and wanted to enjoy a health looking piggy at supper. “Come outside! I wish to talk to you,” said the big vicious wolf and and puffed outside the straw house. “I do not want to come outside. I would like to remain inside,” replied the first laziest little piggy with a soft voice. “I’ll force you to come outside whether you like it or not,” the big vicious wolf grumbled and blew the straw house with strength. Suddenly, the straw house which was weakened fell down. Then the only option the first laziest little piggy could do was to escape.
text.T1: Kono zazi lelitatama luwawa lolumaswe lolubuhali ni butuna lwataha. Luwawa loo nelushwile tala mi nelubata kulube yende ya kuishalula fa mulalelo. “Taha kwande, nibata kuambola ni wena," luwawa lolumaswe lolubuhali ni butuna lwabulumela kwa kabuma ka bucwañi. “Hanilati kutaha koo. Niitakaleza kuina mona mo moniinzi,” kakulube kapili kaalaba ka linzwi leli mwataasi. “Nika kuhapeleza kuzwela kwande, koulata ni kousalati,” luwawa lolumaswe lolubuhali ni butuna lwakowana ni kufuta moya ka maata alona kaufela. Hañihañi kabuma ka bucwañi kane kase kashekesha kawa. Nto iliñwi feela yewo kakulube kapili nekakona kueza ki kubaleha.

text.S1: The first little pig ran to take shelter in the wooden house of the second little pig. The big bad wolf grew angrier and within a few minutes approached the second little pig’s wooden house. “It’s two little pigs that I will have now,” he thought. He banged on the door and shouted, “I’ll get you, and you shall not escape me.” “I hope that your house will stand better than mine,” said the worried first little pig to the second little pig. Seeing that he could not get in, the big bad wolf stepped back, puffed up his lungs and blew with all his might. The wooden house didn’t take much longer than the straw house to fall down. It collapsed plank by plank and the two little pigs started to run as fast as they could.
text.S2: The first laziest little piggy ran as fast he could to the pole house of the second little piggy to take cover. The big vicious wolf was furious and followed to the pole house of the second little piggy. “I’ll have to eat two little piggies now,” the big vicious wolf decided. Soon he knocked at pole house’s door and shouted in a loud voice, “When I catch you, you shall not escape.” “I hope that your house is stronger than mine,” the first laziest little piggy said to the second little piggy in fear. After realising that it was not possible to enter the pole house, the big vicious wolf reverse to gain momentum, so he huffed and he puffed and blew the pole house down. The pole house fell down faster than the straw house as each plank fell off one by one then the two little piggies ran as fast as possible for safety.
text.T1: Kakulube kapili kamatela kuyoipata kwa kandu ka likota ka kakulube kabubeli. Luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna lwafilikana ni kunyema hahulu mi hañihañi lwafita kwa kandu ka likota ka kakulube kabubeli. “Ki tukulube totubeli tonikaca cwale,” lwanahana. Lwanata fa sikwalo ni kuhuwa lwali, “Nikamiswala, mi hamuna kuni picuka. “Nisepa kuli ndu yahao itiile kufita yaaka,” kakulube kapili ka kuikalelwa kabulelela kakulube kabubeli. Ka kubona kuli nelusa koni kukena, luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna lwakuta mwamulaho, lwapumata moya ni kutunduluka kona lifuta moya ka maata alona amatuna hahulu. Ndu ya likota nei sikaanga nako yetelele kwa kuwa kufita kabuma ka bucwañi. Kawa ka libala ni libala mi tukulube totubeli twakala kumata hahulu ka lubilo lolutuna.

text.S1: They arrive at their brother’s house, the third little pig. Just in time, because the wolf was about to catch them. “Come in! Quick, quick!” he screamed. “I told you that your houses wouldn’t stand!” By now, the big bad wolf was getting increasingly hungry and angry. He tried to break open the door but only succeeded in hurting his legs. The third little pig reassured his brothers, “We are safe here. This house is very solid. The big bad wolf won’t be able to destroy it.” Indeed, the big bad wolf didn’t know what to do. He grew restless and kicked the door and the walls all over but neither the door nor the wall moved by an inch!
text.S2: The two little piggies ran faster to the third littlle piggy’s house in good time. As the big vicious wolf almost caught them, the third littlle piggy shouted and invited them, “Enter quickly! Quick! Quick!” I advised you that your houses you built would not be strong enough. At this point in time, the big vicious wolf was very hungry and angry. He tried to break the door in order to go in. Unfortunately, he injured his legs in the process. The third littlle piggy consoled the other two piggies, “We are protected here. This house is very strong. The big vicious wolf won’t manage to destroy it.” It was proved that the big vicious wolf would not know what to do. He struggled to break the house through kicking the door and brick walls in order to weaken them but all in vain, the house did not even shake.
text.T1: Twafita kwa ndu ya muhabotona ili kakulube kabulaalu ka nako yeswanela. Bakeñisa kuli luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna nese lubata kutuswala kakulube kabulalu kahuwa kali, “Amukene! Kabubebe! Neni mibulelezi kuli mandu amina haana kutiya!” Ka nako ye luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna nese lushwile hahulu tala ni kunyema ka taata. Lalika kupwaca sikwalo kuli lukwalule kono feela sene likonile kueza neeli kui kolofaza kwa mahutu alona. Kakulube kabulaalu katiisa bahabokona kali, “Lusilelelizwe mo. Ndu ye itiile. Luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna haluna kukona kuisinya.” Kaniti, luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna nelu sikakona kuziba sakueza. Atundana kataata ka kulahaka sikwalo ni mamota kai ni kai nihakulicwalo, sikwalo kapa mamota naa sika nyanganya nihaiba hanyinyani!

text.S2: “I’ll strongly blow your house until it falls down like what happened to the other houses,” shouted the big vicious wolf. “You can keep on trying like that,” responded the third little piggy. “However, you wo’t ever manage to enter inside my house because it is very strong.” “Let us wait and see,” threatened the big vicious wolf.

text.S1: And he began to blow and blow, and blow during long minutes, but the house still stood. The third little pig opened the window carefully and saw that the big bad wolf looked completely exhausted. This made the three little pigs laugh and they felt perfectly safe now.
text.S2: Then the big vicious wolf started blowing the air continously for a long time on the house which still stood firmly on the ground. The third little piggy carefully opened the window and saw the big vicious wolf very exhausted. The scenario made the three little piggies laugh at the big vicious wolf and felt secured.

text.S1: But the big bad wolf wasn’t finished talking. “Don’t think I’m giving up,” said the big bad wolf. “I’m really hungry now!” The wolf was thinking. If he can’t destroy the house, there must be a way to get in. “Maybe in disguise?” wondered the wolf. “If they don’t recognize me, there might be a chance they open the door”, he said. “Oh no! These 3 little pigs are too smart, they’ll recognize me! I need to think of something else!” He saw the ladder that had been used by the third little pig to build his house. “That’s what I’ll do,” thought the big bad wolf, “I’ll go down the chimney.” And he climbed on to the roof.
text.S2: The third little piggy was very clever. He observed what the big vicious wolf was planning to do, so he informed his relatives about it, “I believe that the big vicious wolf has leaped onto the roof and is trying to climb down the chimney! Can you quickly light the fire?” By then the big vicious wolf had already climbed down the chimney and was unable to ascend the chimney for him to come out to the roof. So he continued to go down the chimney. In that regard, he dropped in fire as a result he burnt his back and tail. He roared with a loud noise as he ran away to the entrance which the third little piggy deliberately left open

text.T3: Kakulube kabulaalu neka talifile hahulu. Neka boni sewo luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna nelu lelile kueza mi kataluseza bahabokona kali, “Nilumela kuli luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna luinzi fa situwa mi lusweli lwalika kukenela mwa muyengo! Hamwakufe, mutukise mulilo.” Luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna nese lukeni mwa muyengo mi nelusa koni kukambama kuli luzwele fahalimu, kona kuli lwaekeza kushulumukela mwa muyengo. Latowela fa mulilo mi laca mwa mukokoto ni kwa muhata. Lwahuwa ni kumata ka lubilo lolutuna hahulu ni kuzwela mwa munyako woo kakulube kabulaalu neka siile siyamena kamabomu.

text.S1: The three little pigs, came out of the house to watch the wolf run and jump around like a rabbit. “Ha ha ha ha! We got him good!” cried out the three brothers at the same time. After such an experience, the first and second lazy little pigs decided to also build a brick house for themselves. And once the work was completed, they went back to playing, singing, and dancing. As for the big bad wolf, nobody ever saw him again.
text.S2: The three little piggies then went outside the house to watch how the big vicious wolf was running about and jumping up and down like a hare. “Hoo! Hoo! Hoo! We have fixed him!” shoutd and achored the three little piggies at the same time. After that action, the first and the second lazy piggies decided to construct their own brick houses. Therefore, after they had acomplished their tasks they returned to their play stations to dance and sing. As for the big vicious wolf, nobody ever saw him again.
text.T1: Tukulube totulaalu, twazwela kwande ni kubuha luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna halunze lumata ni kutulaka-tulaka sina kashakame. “Ha! ha! ha! Lulilukisize!” kwahuweleza tukulube totulaalu ka nako yeswana. Hasamulaho wa kezo yewo, tukulube totulondile ili kakulube kapili ni kabubeli twalela kuicahela mandu atona a sitina. Mi musebezi hause ufelile, bakutela kwa kubapala, kuopela ni kubina. Haili luwawa lolumaswe, lolubuhali ni butuna, nelusika bonwa ki mutu ufi kamba ufi hape.
